audit.why: 46.03% over 63 games — a losing lane, and the entry concedes level 1 and the two-item mark while claiming 4-6. That is the right shape for the number.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why writes 'Between the Worlds' and never says what Urgot's 6 does.
audit.why: Fear Beyond Death is 100s at rank 1 down to 70s, fires 2500 units, impales the first champion hit and executes below a health threshold. That threshold is the reason every leap that leaves you low is fatal, and the entry gestures at it without ever giving the number or the range.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now names both ultimates and gives the 2500 range and 100s cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Disdain's shield is never mentioned, and Purge's cooldown scaling is absent.
audit.why: Disdain (E, 16s at rank 1 down to 14s, 475 range) shields him as he charges — so the flip is not just displacement, it eats the burst window you were saving. Force it out before you commit rather than after. And Purge (W) goes 12s at rank 1 to 0s at rank 5: by the time he maxes it there is no cooldown window on his damage at all, which is why the entry's 'poke and slide out' plan has an expiry date it never states.
audit.corrected: Cooldown block rebuilt on Disdain's shield and Purge's 12s-to-0s scaling.

audit.whatIsWrong: early, late and all seven whys are written in the FIRST person — 'my Spirit Abjuration', 'I concede it', 'the trade I never take'. Every other entry uses second person.
audit.why: The site speaks to the player as 'you'. A first-person block reads as someone else's diary and breaks the voice mid-page.
audit.corrected: early and late converted to second person; the seven whys need the same scripted pass and are flagged.
